name: LLM-supported translation
summary: POST /translator/text/translate with targets[].deploymentName='{conn}/{model}' to use an LLM for translation.
description: New translator API (api-version=2026-06-06) that accepts a deploymentName per target language. This is the same diagnostic shape as image-generation-direct — does the endpoint parse the BYOM prefix, or treat it as a literal deployment lookup?
notes: Calls FOUNDRY_ACCOUNT_ENDPOINT (account-level, not project). Requires Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region header.
